item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is making a torch circuit for her school science project in Jaipur. The figure shows the actual circuit she has connected on her table: one cell, a closed switch and one bulb, joined in a single loop with wires.

Which circuit diagram correctly represents Meera's circuit?

options.A: A cell and a bulb in series, with no switch shown.
options.B: A cell, a closed switch and a bulb, all in series in one loop.
options.C: A cell with the switch and the bulb connected in parallel branches.
options.D: Two cells and a bulb in series, with the switch left open.
